         BEFORE THE CORPORATION COMMISSION OF THE STATE OF OKLAHOMA

          IN THE MATTER OF THE APPLICATION OF
          OKLAHOMA GAS AND ELECTRIC
          COMPANY FOR COMMISSION APPROVAL
          OF ELECTRIC SERVICE AGREEMENTS                               PUD 2026-000031
          AND PREAPPROVAL OF CAPACITY
          PURCHASE AGREEMENTS PURSUANT TO
          17 O.S. § 286(C)


                           ATTORNEY GENERAL’S SURREBUTTAL OUTLINE

                Gentner F. Drummond, the Attorney General of Oklahoma, on behalf of the utility

         customers of this State, hereby submits his Surrebuttal Outline in the proceeding referenced above.

         The Attorney General identifies the following areas of rebuttal testimony that may be addressed

         by witnesses in oral sur-rebuttal testimony at the hearing on the merits:

         Frank J. Beling

         Kimber L. Shoop
         Rebuttal 2:15–22, 6:19–28

         Jason J. Thenmadathil
         Rebuttal 2:22–27, 3:12–19, 4:10–12, 4:16–23

         Adrian J. Kimbrough
         Rebuttal 13:10–17, 14:11–14

                Further, the Attorney General reserves the right to supplement this Surrebuttal Outline as

         new material information becomes available prior to the closing of the evidentiary record of the

         hearing on the merits.
